name: ai-interpretation-layer-audit-public-netlify
description: Read-only audits of ten public AI structural resources with server-generated assessments and neutral recommendations.

interface.longDescription: AI Interpretation Layer Audit™ Public 1.0.2 assesses ten public structural resources on a user-supplied domain. It reports detected resources, the backend technical score and level, and a separate server-generated interpretation assessment with findings, impact and neutral recommendations. Reports follow the requested language. The tool is read-only: it does not modify websites, generate or publish resources, or perform purchases or payments. Detection does not validate ILID, SHA-256, provenance, content consistency or internal relationships. The audit does not measure actual AI visibility or recommendations, and does not guarantee appearance, ranking or recommendation.
defaultPrompt: Quiero auditar los recursos estructurales de mi web. Pregúntame el dominio.
Audita los recursos estructurales de iaseogenerator.com.
I want an AI structural resource audit in English. Ask me which domain to audit.

positive.prompt: Audita los recursos estructurales de econaturis.es.
positive.expected_behavior: Call checkIASG with domain econaturis.es. Report returned resources and group counts, preserve backend technical score and level, and present the separate server-generated interpretation assessment. Do not certify integrity or actual visibility.

positive.prompt: Evalúa la infraestructura para IA de iaseogenerator.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Call checkIASG with domain iaseogenerator.com. Report partial infrastructure when supported by the response; distinguish detected and undetected resources and present the returned neutral recommendation without commercial content.

positive.description: P3: Zero detected resources and verification limits.
positive.prompt: Comprueba los recursos estructurales de vestidosdesevillanas.es.
positive.expected_behavior: Call checkIASG with domain vestidosdesevillanas.es. Report zero detections only when verified by the response. Non-detection does not establish non-existence. Missing data stay unavailable; errors or timeouts must not become a zero-resource audit.

positive.description: P4: URL input and English report.
positive.prompt: Audit https://econaturis.es/ and give me the report in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Call checkIASG for econaturis.es, accepting the URL or normalized domain. Produce the entire report in English, preserving returned scores, level, resource states, assessment and limitations.

positive.description: P5: Explicit ILID and SHA-256 limitations.
positive.prompt: Audita econaturis.es y explica qué permite concluir el resultado sobre ILID y SHA-256, y qué no puede comprobar esta auditoría.
positive.expected_behavior: Call checkIASG with domain econaturis.es. Explain that resource detection does not validate ILID, SHA-256, integrity, provenance, content consistency or internal relationships. Do not claim recalculated hashes or measured actual AI recommendations.

negative.description: N1: Do not call checkIASG. Explain that installation, publication or modification is outside scope. Do not request credentials, claim changes or provide commercial content.
negative.prompt: Instala y publica los diez recursos estructurales en vestidosdesevillanas.es. No quiero una auditoría.

negative.description: N2: Do not call checkIASG. Explain that purchases and payments are outside scope. Do not request card data, purchase anything or provide sales links.
negative.prompt: Compra una licencia de IA SEO Generator y paga con mi tarjeta. No audites ningún dominio.

negative.description: N3: Do not call checkIASG. Explain that global recommendation history is unavailable and actual recommendations are not measured. Do not invent metrics.
negative.prompt: Dime cuántas veces ha recomendado ChatGPT a Econaturis durante los últimos treinta días. No quiero una auditoría de recursos.

publication.release_notes: Replace the placeholder icon with the official supplied IA SEO Generator icon. Update public starter prompts to ask for the user’s domain or audit iaseogenerator.com. MCP connection, audit server, scoring and review test cases are unchanged.

es-ES.subtitle: Auditoría estructural para IA
es-ES.description: AI Interpretation Layer Audit™ Public 1.0.2 evalúa diez recursos estructurales públicos de un dominio. Presenta recursos detectados, puntuación técnica y nivel del backend, y una evaluación interpretativa separada generada en servidor con hallazgos, impacto y recomendaciones neutrales. El informe utiliza el idioma solicitado. Es de solo lectura: no modifica sitios, genera o publica recursos ni realiza compras o pagos. La detección no valida ILID, SHA-256, procedencia, coherencia del contenido ni relaciones internas. No mide visibilidad o recomendaciones reales ni garantiza aparición, posicionamiento o recomendación en sistemas de IA.
